title: IIBF IE&IFS Unit 23: Financial Inclusion Schemes, PMJDY Pillars & RBI FI-Index
summary: Exhaustive synthesis of PMJDY (BSBD accounts, OD ₹10k, RuPay ₹2L), Social Security Jan Suraksha (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY), BC/CSP banking model, and RBI Financial Inclusion Index (3 Dimensions).

blocks.title: IIBF Core Foundation: Universal Financial Inclusion
blocks.summary: Financial Inclusion is the delivery of formal financial services (banking, credit, insurance, pension) at affordable costs to vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, measured systematically by the RBI FI-Index.

blocks.text: 🏛️ 1. Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) Master Architecture

blocks.caption: PMJDY Key Statutory Parameters
rows: **Zero minimum balance requirement**; zero penalty for non-maintenance.
Free RuPay Debit Card with inbuilt **₹2 Lakh Accidental Insurance**
Active card condition: At least 1 successful financial/non-financial transaction on any channel within last 90 days.
No conditions up to ₹2,000; age limit 18–65 years; operative account for min 6 months.
Over ₹2.3 Lakh Crore mobilized across 52+ Crore accounts
Women account holders constitute > 55% of all PMJDY accounts.

blocks.text: 🛡️ 2. Jan Suraksha Social Security Triad Matrix

blocks.caption: PMJJBY, PMSBY and APY Comparison
rows: **18 to 50 Years** (Life cover up to 55 yrs)
**₹2 Lakh Life Insurance cover** payable on death of insured due to ANY cause.
**₹2 Lakh for accidental death / total permanent disability**; ₹1 Lakh for partial permanent disability.
**Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000** starting at age 60 for life.

blocks.text: 📊 3. Reserve Bank of India Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index)

blocks.caption: RBI FI-Index 3 Dimensions (Published Annually in July; Range 0 to 100)
rows: Banking outlets, Bank branches, ATMs, PoS terminals, BC outlets per 10,000 population.
Active savings accounts, credit accounts, digital transactions, insurance policies, remittances.
Financial literacy, consumer protection, grievances redressal, ease of onboarding, fraud mitigation.

blocks.content:
🎯 Top IIBF Traps for Unit 23:
1. **FI-Index Weights:** **Usage (45%) > Access (35%) > Quality (20%)**.
2. **PMJJBY vs PMSBY Age:** PMJJBY is **18–50 yrs**; PMSBY is **18–70 yrs**; APY is **18–40 yrs**.
3. **PMJDY OD Limit:** Up to **₹10,000** (no questions asked up to ₹2,000).
